title: One Axis, No Brake: Self-Knowledge Limits the Filtering of Harmful Peer Conformity in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.18998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are expected to be more reliable because agents can catch each other's mistakes. But peer pressure cuts both ways: the same correction that fixes a wrong answer can overturn a right one. The tempting safeguard is a brake that keeps the beneficial revisions and blocks the harmful ones. We show this brake is hard to build, for a simple reason: a revision is harmful exactly when the original answer was right, so deciding whether to block it is the same as knowing whether the model was already correct. This turns the open-ended hunt for a brake into one measurable quantity, the model's self-knowledge: any brake built from a deploy-time signal is a correctness probe in disguise, and self-knowledge is far from perfect (AUROC $\approx 0.64$--$0.89$ across six model families). We call this ceiling the wall. Even white-box steering of the model's own correctness direction does not breach it: it changes how often the mode

translated_title: 一个维度，无刹车：自我认知限制了LLM中对有害同伴从众行为的过滤
translated_abstract: 多智能体LLM系统被期望更加可靠，因为各个智能体可以互相捕捉错误。但同伴压力是双刃剑：纠正错误答案的同一机制也可能推翻原本正确的答案。一个诱人的保障方案是设置一个“刹车”，保留有益的修正并阻止有害的修正。我们证明这种刹车很难构建，原因很简单：修正恰好仅在原答案正确时才有害，因此决定是否阻止修正与判断模型本身是否正确是同一件事。这将开放式地寻找刹车的问题转化为一个可测量的量——模型的自我认知：任何基于部署时信号构建的刹车本质上都是伪装的正确性探测器，而自我认知远非完美（在六个模型家族中AUROC约为0.64–0.89）。我们将这一上限称为“墙”。即使对模型自身的正确性方向进行白盒引导也无法突破它：它改变的是模式……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了在多智能体LLM中过滤有害同伴从众的“刹车”本质上等价于伪装的正确性探测器，因此受限于模型不完美的自我认知（AUROC仅0.64–0.89），这一“墙”即使用白盒引导也无法突破。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that any brake for filtering harmful peer conformity in multi-agent LLMs is essentially a disguised correctness probe, so the model's imperfect self-knowledge (AUROC 0.64–0.89) forms an unbeatable wall that even white-box steering cannot breach.
